claim: NVIDIA DriveOS offers Linux or QNX as the application OS; its SDK bundles DriveWorks, CUDA, cuDNN and TensorRT; it claims ISO 26262, ASPICE and ISO/SAE 21434 compliance (TÜV SÜD)

DRIVE OS 6.0.9 QNX docs: CUDA for aarch64 QNX is installed in /usr/local/cuda-targets/aarch64-qnx/, built with CUDA_PATH=/usr/local/cuda-safe-11.4 for the Orin GPU (SMS=87); i.e. CUDA exists on a non-Linux kernel, but only in the DRIVE program and at CUDA 11.4
QNX Everywhere release notes (June 19 2026 update): 'The ROS (Robot Operating System) 2 APK is now available. (QNXE-1601)'
Fuchsia: Google cut at least 16% (later reported >20%) of the ~400-person team in Jan 2023 and in July 2023 marked its smart-speaker targets unsupported and removed the code

seL4 use page: production deployments include NIO ONVO L60 (SkyOS-M, mass-produced), DornerWorks VM Composer, Kry10 KOS; robotics use (HACMS trucks, land robot, quadcopter, Boeing ULB) was DARPA research

seL4 tools page: CAmkES 'eventually to be replaced by Microkit, but still supported'; Microkit 'in active development ... not all features and configurations supported yet', MCS configs only; Microkit VMM AArch64 only (RISC-V in development)
